about: The article of law that gives a court its say in a step of a case: by the tier of the court, the procedure the metadata names (psi:procedure, its start) and the area of law (dc:subject). Read by core/judgment_course.py. Kept by hand from the text of the laws; a step none of them fits has no basis (a gap), never a guessed one. A rule with after_tier hears only the judgments of that court (cassation in bestuur: only against the Centrale Raad van Beroep). The other articles that give the court its say in a step of the route, by tier, procedure and area, are under designations (the route, not a step of the Verloop): the article of the Bevoegdheidsregeling bestuursrechtspraak (Awb bijlage 2) that names a court, the Awb beside the RO in tax cases, the laws that open cassation against the Centrale Raad van Beroep (those read, not all there may be). Known gaps, not read in the source: under gaps.
